8.name: Asha reviews corrected filing stack
8.description: Asha holds the marked page, then slides the corrected stack to the table's edge and aligns it carefully, signaling her focus on the filing's proper handling.
evidence: The marked page stayed under Asha's palm a long minute before she lifted her hand and slid the corrected stack to the edge of the table, lining the spines up against the grain of the wood

8.name: Asha worries about filing chain of custody
8.description: Asha considers how the Tuesday filing will move into Monday's record and whose name will be attached to it, revealing her concern about responsibility and consequences.
evidence: what remained was the narrower one of how that page would travel from this kitchen into Monday's record, and through whose name
what it would cost him, and her, to put either of their names beside that X in front of Whitfield on Monday morning

8.name: Rosa clears the mugs
8.description: Rosa silently takes the empty mugs to the sink, leaving Asha alone with the paperwork and her phone.
evidence: Rosa rose without a word and carried the empty mugs to the sink, leaving Asha alone with the stack and with the soft buzz of her phone face-down beside it

8.name: Calendar reminder alerts Asha
8.description: Asha's phone buzzes with a second alert for the seven a.m. partners' meeting, underscoring the urgency of her obligations.
evidence: the soft buzz of her phone face-down beside it, where a calendar reminder for the seven a.m. partners' meeting had just lit the screen for the second time

8.name: Asha checks the reminder without opening message
8.description: Asha turns over her phone and reads the sender line but delays opening the message, showing hesitation.
evidence: She turned the phone over, read the sender line, and did not yet open it

8.name: Asha reflects on Devin's signature
8.description: Asha thinks about Devin, who signed Tuesday's page because she had been unreachable for three days, and weighs the cost to both of them.
evidence: she was thinking, instead, about Devin—the second-year who had signed Tuesday's page in good faith because she had not answered her phone for three days

8.name: Rosa asks about calling Devin
8.description: Rosa breaks the silence by asking Asha when she will call Devin, pushing the issue into the open.
evidence: "So," she said, quiet, "when do you call Devin?"

8.name: Asha opens a new message
8.description: After hesitating, Asha begins composing or opening a new message on her phone in response to Rosa's question.
evidence: Asha didn't answer right away; she turned the phone upright in her hand, thumbed past the calendar reminder without dismissing it, and opened a new me

8.name: asks when to call Devin
8.description: Rosa asks Asha when she will call Devin, prompting the next action.
evidence: "So," she said, quiet, "when do you call Devin?"

8.name: sends message to Devin
8.description: Asha ignores the question briefly, opens a new message to Devin, edits it, and sends an invitation to come by that night.
evidence: Asha didn't answer right away; she turned the phone upright in her hand, thumbed past the calendar reminder without dismissing it, and opened a new message to Devin instead.

She typed Can you come by my place tonight, I need to talk to you, read it once, deleted the comma and put a period in, and sent it before she could weigh the word tonight against the word tomorrow any longer.

8.name: states Devin has been contacted
8.description: Asha places the phone down and says 'Now,' signaling that the message has been sent and the waiting has begun.
evidence: Then she set the phone face up on the corrected stack, where the screen would light when he answered, and said, to Rosa or to the table, "Now."

8.name: Rosa leaves the kitchen
8.description: Rosa slowly withdraws from the kitchen toward the hallway, giving Asha space.
evidence: Rosa eased her knuckles off the back of the chair and walked the length of the kitchen toward the doorway, slower than she needed to, the dish towel still folded over her wrist.

8.name: Asha waits for Devin's reply
8.description: Asha watches the unsent-looking thread and waits as the phone remains silent and the calendar reminder continues underneath.
evidence: Asha didn't turn to watch her go; she picked the phone up off the corrected stack, woke the screen, and opened the thread with Devin so the single sent line sat alone at the bottom of the glass.
The typing indicator did not appear.

She held the phone in both hands the way she would hold a brief she was about to file, thumb resting just below the message, and listened to Rosa's footsteps stop in the hall and then start again, leaving her with the stack and the unblinking screen and the calendar reminder still ticking quietly underneath.

8.name: sets phone down and continues waiting
8.description: When the screen dims without any response, Asha stops trying to wake it and leaves the phone face-up on the folder while she waits.
evidence: When the screen finally dimmed without changing, she did not press it back to light; she set the phone face-up on the top folder, where the red X bled faintly through, and waited.

8.name: Asha waits after the screen dims
8.description: Asha leaves the phone face-up on the folder and waits instead of trying to wake the screen again.
evidence: she did not press it back to light; she set the phone face-up on the top folder, where the red X bled faintly through, and waited.

8.name: Rosa asks whether Devin answered
8.description: Rosa returns to the doorway and quietly asks Asha if Devin has answered her message.
evidence: "Did he answer?" she asked, quiet enough that Asha could have pretended not to hear.

8.name: Asha checks the unanswered thread
8.description: Asha wakes the phone, scrolls the message thread, and confirms that Devin still has not replied.
evidence: Asha picked the phone up off the top folder and woke the screen, the red X bleeding faintly through under the glass, and scrolled the thread up and down once as if Devin's reply might be hiding above her own sent line rather than under it.
"Not yet," she said, and set the phone back down face up, the single message still alone at the bottom.

8.name: Rosa stays nearby in silence
8.description: Rosa remains in the doorway while Asha does not ask her to leave, and the kitchen falls briefly silent except for the reminder buzzing.
evidence: Rosa did not move from the doorway, and Asha did not ask her to, and for a moment the only sound in the kitchen was the calendar reminder buzzing once more against the wood.

8.name: Asha calls Devin
8.description: Asha decides not to check the thread again and instead calls Devin directly.
evidence: Asha picked the phone back up off the folder and, instead of waking the thread again, pressed Devin's name and held the phone to her ear.

8.name: Rosa moves closer to listen
8.description: Rosa leaves the doorway and comes back into the kitchen to stand near Asha while she waits on the call.
evidence: Behind her she heard Rosa's hand leave the doorframe and her footsteps come back into the kitchen, not all the way to the table but close enough that Asha could feel her standing at her shoulder, the dish towel still over her wrist.

8.name: Devin answers the call
8.description: Devin picks up after two rings, sounding clipped and already occupied with work.
evidence: The line rang twice and Devin picked up, his voice clipped the way it got when he was already working

8.name: Asha asks Devin to come tonight
8.description: Asha tells Devin she needs him at her apartment tonight and begins to explain that it concerns something important.
evidence: Asha said his name and then, before he could ask, told him she needed him at her apartment tonight, that it was about

8.name: Asha calls Devin about filing
8.description: Asha phones Devin, asks him to come to her apartment tonight, and says it concerns Tuesday's filing.
evidence: Asha said his name and then, before he could ask, told him she needed him at her apartment tonight, that it was about Tuesday's filing

8.name: Devin agrees to come later
8.description: Devin says he will come after he finishes the Hatcher exhibits.
evidence: until he said he'd come after he finished the Hatcher exhibits

8.name: Asha hides the corrected folder
8.description: Asha puts the top folder from the corrected stack into her briefcase, keeping the marked material out of sight.
evidence: Asha lifted the top folder off the stack, the red X still visible at the corner, and slid it into her briefcase on the chair beside her

8.name: Briefcase latch snaps shut
8.description: Asha closes the briefcase with a sharper-than-intended click that echoes through the kitchen.
evidence: The latch clicked once, sharper than she meant it, and the sound carried in the kitchen the way a closing door did in an empty house

8.name: Rosa asks what happens next
8.description: From the doorway, Rosa asks Asha what they do now, signaling tension after the phone call.
evidence: "And now?" she asked

8.name: Asha withholds an answer
8.description: Asha keeps her hand on the briefcase and does not respond to Rosa's question.
evidence: Asha kept her hand on the briefcase a moment longer
and did not answer her yet

8.name: Rosa slides the phone back
8.description: Rosa approaches the table and quietly pushes the phone toward Asha without fully touching her.
evidence: Rosa took the two steps to the table and, without quite touching Asha, slid the phone off the corrected stack toward her

8.name: Asha turns to face Rosa
8.description: Asha releases the briefcase handle, exhales, and looks up at Rosa instead of at the phone.
evidence: Asha let go of the briefcase handle and let her breath out, slow enough that Rosa would hear it, and looked up at her instead of at the screen

8.name: Asha silently decides about Devin
8.description: Asha withholds her decision about Devin verbally, leaving Rosa to infer the answer from her silence.
evidence: She did not say what she had decided about Devin, and Rosa did not ask again; the phone sat between them with his name still at the top of the thread, and that was apparently enough to count as an answer for now.

8.name: Asha pockets the phone in her briefcase
8.description: Asha takes the phone on her own terms and puts it in the outside pocket of her briefcase before leaving.
evidence: Asha picked it up, this time on her own terms, and slipped it into the outside pocket of the briefcase where she would feel it against her hip on the way to the car.

8.name: Asha closes the briefcase and stands to leave
8.description: Asha shuts the briefcase, rises from the table, and prepares to go.
evidence: Asha closed the briefcase latches one after the other, each click smaller than the last, and stood.

8.name: Rosa yields the doorway without protest
8.description: As Asha moves toward the door, Rosa steps aside and lets her pass without forcing the issue.
evidence: She did not look at Rosa as she came around the table, only at the doorway past her, and Rosa stepped aside without making her ask.

8.name: Rosa resumes quiet kitchen work
8.description: After Asha leaves the table, Rosa returns to drying dishes in her habitual slow, even manner.
evidence: Behind her, Rosa picked up the dish towel from where she had folded it on her wrist and went to the counter, lifting a wet glass from the rack and beginning to dry it in the same slow, even motion she used for everything else in this kitchen.

8.name: Asha leaves the house
8.description: Asha exits through the front door, hearing Rosa continue drying dishes behind her.
evidence: The sound of the towel against the glass followed Asha down the hall, steady enough that she could hear it past the front door as she pulled it shut

8.name: Asha realizes Rosa will wait and watch
8.description: Asha understands that Rosa will not press her again but will instead wait to see what she does.
evidence: and she understood, the way she had understood the phone sliding across the table, that Rosa was not going to ask her again what she had decided, only wait to see what she did.

8.name: Asha drives east toward her destination
8.description: Asha heads east in her car with the briefcase secured beside her, continuing the scene beyond the house.
evidence: Asha drove east with both hands on the wheel and the briefcase belted into the passenger seat

8.name: drives east while avoiding the phone
8.description: Asha drives east with the briefcase secured beside her and deliberately avoids looking at the phone as it lights up repeatedly.
evidence: Asha drove east with both hands on the wheel and the briefcase belted into the passenger seat like something that might shift if she took a corner too fast.
The phone sat in the outside pocket against her hip, lit twice on the way out of the neighborhood and then again at the first long red, and she did not look down.

8.name: rehearses Devin signature mentally
8.description: While driving, Asha mentally runs through the signature block and holds both possible versions of Devin's name without deciding yet.
evidence: She kept her eyes on the brake lights ahead and ran the signature block in her head instead, the line where Devin's name would go and the line where it had not gone, and found she could hold both versions in her mind at once without choosing between them yet.

8.name: recognizes phone silence as solitude
8.description: When the phone goes quiet by the time she reaches her street, Asha interprets the silence as a brief chance to be alone with her decision.
evidence: By the time she turned onto her own street the phone had gone quiet, and she understood that the quiet was not relief so much as the small grace of being alone with the decision for the length of a staircase and a key in a lock.

8.name: pauses before opening her door
8.description: Asha stops on the landing outside her door with the key ready in her hand, hesitating before going inside.
evidence: Asha stopped on the landing one step short of her door and stood with the key already chosen between her fingers.

8.name: touches phone without checking it
8.description: She reaches into the briefcase pocket and touches the phone without lifting it or looking at the screen, lingering over Devin's thread.
evidence: She did not take it out of her hand, but she reached with the other into the outside pocket of the briefcase and laid two fingers against the phone without lifting it or turning the screen toward her.

The case was warm where it had been against her hip in the car, and she could feel the faint edge of the device through the leather, Devin's name still presumably at the top of the thread she had not reopened since the kitchen.

8.name: lingers before confirming the phone
8.description: Asha holds her fingers on the phone longer than necessary, delaying the moment of checking it.
evidence: She held the contact for a breath longer than she needed to confirm the phone wa

8.name: Asha enters with unresolved message thread
8.description: Asha comes inside still carrying the unresolved thread about Devin, aware she must address it soon.
evidence: Devin's name still presumably at the top of the thread she had not reopened since the kitchen.
whatever she said to him tonight she would have to say in the next hour

8.name: Asha checks the phone thread
8.description: Inside, Asha sets down her briefcase and opens the phone thread to review Devin's messages.
evidence: Inside, Asha set the briefcase on the kitchen table without taking off her coat and lifted the phone out of the outside pocket.
The thread was where she had left it, Devin's name at the top, three unanswered messages stacked beneath the one she had opened from the car on Wednesday.

8.name: Asha rereads Devin's messages
8.description: She scrolls back through the conversation and rereads the full exchange, including his offer to sign and the later filing update.
evidence: She scrolled to the beginning and read all of it this time, the Tuesday afternoon I can sign this if you want and her own delayed go ahead, then the line that came later, Filed at 4:51, signature block attached, and the photo of the page with his name where hers should have been.
She read it twice, then a third time, slower

8.name: Asha realizes Devin filed the document
8.description: As she rereads the timestamps, Asha understands that Devin acted on her instruction and filed the document with his signature in her place.
evidence: until the order of the messages stopped rearranging itself in her head and what remained was the simple fact of the timestamps and the boy who had taken her at her word.

8.name: Asha sets phone aside and removes coat
8.description: She puts the phone face-down, takes off her coat, and leaves it draped over a chair instead of hanging it up.
evidence: Asha turned the phone face-down on the table and finally shrugged out of her coat, draping it over the back of the chair instead of hanging it up.

8.name: Asha begins drafting a correction
8.description: Asha takes out a legal pad and starts writing the formal correction she will need to submit.
evidence: She pulled a legal pad from the briefcase and uncapped a pen, and began writing out the correction in the spare, formal phrasing she would need on the page itself

8.name: writes correction draft
8.description: Asha sits down and drafts a formal correction explaining the filing error and the proper attorney of record.
evidence: She pulled a legal pad from the briefcase and uncapped a pen, and began writing out the correction in the spare, formal phrasing she would need on the page itself: the line identifying the original signatory, the line substituting the correct attorney of record, the short note explaining that the Tuesday filing had been executed by a junior associate under her supervision while she was out of state.

8.name: rewrites Devin's name carefully
8.description: She rewrites the correction a second time, deliberately placing Devin's name where it belongs without crossing it out.
evidence: She wrote it twice, the second time slower, watching her own hand form Devin's name in the block where it would actually belong, and she did not cross it out.

8.name: composes firm text message
8.description: Asha opens the message thread and sends Devin a direct text saying she is coming over and they need to talk.
evidence: Asha turned the phone over and woke the screen.
The thread was still open to the photo of the filing, Devin's name in the block where hers should have been, and she scrolled past it without rereading and typed into the empty field at the bottom.
I am coming to your place. We need to talk.

Then she set the phone screen-up beside the legal pad, where the corrected paragraph with his name in the signature block lay under the cap of her pen, and she waited the few seconds it took for the small gray tick to confirm the message had gone.

8.name: waits for message confirmation
8.description: After sending the text, Asha waits until the message is confirmed delivered.
evidence: she waited the few seconds it took for the small gray tick to confirm the message had gone.

8.name: tears off second draft
8.description: Asha tears the second draft off the legal pad, ending the drafting phase.
evidence: Asha tore the second draft off the legal

8.name: send corrected message
8.description: Asha finishes typing a corrected draft and sends it, waiting for confirmation that the message has gone.
evidence: his name in the signature block lay under the cap of her pen, and she waited the few seconds it took for the small gray tick to confirm the message had gone.

8.name: file draft in briefcase
8.description: Asha tears off the second draft, stacks it with the first, and puts both pages into her briefcase after checking Devin's name in the signature block.
evidence: Asha tore the second draft off the legal pad, set it on top of the first, and squared the edges against the table before sliding both pages into the inner sleeve of her briefcase.
She checked once that Devin's name sat in the signature block where she had written it, then closed the flap and let the latch click.

8.name: ignore unanswered phone
8.description: Asha notices that the message to Devin is still unanswered but deliberately leaves her phone untouched.
evidence: The phone screen was still bright beside her elbow, the message to him delivered and unanswered, and she did not pick it up.

8.name: leave apartment with briefcase
8.description: Asha puts on her coat, takes her briefcase, and heads out of her apartment.
evidence: She lifted her coat off the back of the chair and put it on again, the briefcase already in her hand by the time she reached for the keys.

8.name: descend to garage
8.description: Asha leaves her building and goes down the stairwell to the garage without slowing.
evidence: The stairwell light in her building was still on its night setting when Asha let the door close behind her, and she took the steps down to the garage without slowing.

8.name: drive to Devin's apartment
8.description: Asha drives toward Devin's apartment from memory, carrying the briefcase as if it contains something to be handed over.
evidence: In the car she set the briefcase on the passenger seat with the latch toward her, the way she would have placed a file she meant to hand across a desk, and she pulled out into the street under the sodium lamps.
She drove the route to Devin's apartment by memory, both hands high on the wheel

8.name: inspect briefcase at red light
8.description: Stopped at a red light, Asha looks at the briefcase and recognizes the corrected paragraph inside as she begins to understand the implications of what she has done.
evidence: and at the long red on Spring Garden she let her eyes go to the briefcase and then back to the light.
The corrected paragraph was inside, with his name in the signature block where she had written it twice and not crossed it out, and she had already understood, somewhere between the kitchen table and

8.name: realizes she won't confess
8.description: Asha understands that she will not be the one to go to Whitfield's office and admit the paragraph was hers.
evidence: she had already understood, somewhere between the kitchen table and the car, that she was not going to be the one to walk into Whitfield's office and say it had been hers.
8.location_hint: between the kitchen table and the car

8.name: parks outside Devin's building
8.description: Asha pulls her car to the curb a few doors from Devin's building and turns off the engine.
evidence: Asha pulled to the curb a few doors down from Devin's building and cut the engine.

8.name: pauses before going inside
8.description: She sits still in the car, looking at Devin's lit second-floor window and steadying herself with a slow breath.
evidence: For a moment she sat with both hands still on the wheel, watching the lit second-floor window where she knew his desk was, and she let one slow breath out through her nose

8.name: reaches for the briefcase
8.description: Asha reaches for the briefcase, which is warm from the heater vent.
evidence: before she reached for the briefcase. The latch was warm under her palm from the heater vent.

8.name: carries the briefcase to the house
8.description: She gets out of the car, closes the door quietly, and walks toward Devin's front steps with the briefcase at her side.
evidence: She got out, closed the door quietly so as not to announce herself to the street, and walked the short stretch of sidewalk to his front steps with the briefcase held at her side

8.name: brings Devin's name inside
8.description: Asha carries the briefcase containing the document with Devin's name written inside in her own handwriting.
evidence: the briefcase held at her side the way she had set it on the passenger seat, his name inside it in her own handwriting.
